**Implementation note:** ADX is one of the TA-Lib momentum indicators screened as an above/below-median regime flag in the V15 sweep; no ADX-gated trend trade.

## Description

Only take moving-average or breakout signals when ADX indicates trend strength exceeds a threshold.

## Where it may fit

Markets transitioning into or remaining in strong trends; filters may miss early moves.

## Vehicles

Futures, ETFs, stocks, FX.

## Required data

OHLC bars for ADX and base signal; enough history; costs.

## Caveats

ADX is nondirectional; threshold tuning can overfit.
